probe.shell_headline_template: find <root> -type f -exec stat -f '%z %m' {} + 2>/dev/null | awk '{n++; s+=$1; if(n==1||$1<min)min=$1; if($1>max)max=$1; if(n==1||$2<mt0)mt0=$2; if($2>mt1)mt1=$2} END {printf "files=%d bytes=%d min=%d max=%d mtime=[%d,%d]\n", n,s,min,max,mt0,mt1}'
probe.python_detail_method: eval/py cell: os.walk(root, followlinks=False) over each store -> counts by extension, total/min/median/max bytes, ISO mtime range; format sniff reads only the first line (cap 65536 B) or first 2048 B of smallest/median/largest non-empty samples; files >64MB are counted but never sniffed; JSON classified by parsing first record keys only
probe.cross_check: shell find|stat|awk headline re-run for every store; counts/bytes/mtime epochs matched the python aggregates for all static stores (live stores drifted slightly between passes: omp/codex activity)
probe.first_record_key_sweep: all session-tree .jsonl classified by first-record key shape (aggregate counts only) to separate transcripts from memory/title sidecars

privacy.recorded_fields: counts, bytes, extension tallies, mtime ranges, first-record key names, format labels
